reports.label: Reports
reports.description: Lets members report behavior to the staff.

command.description: Report a member to the staff.
command.message: Discord link to the related message (optional).

feedback.staffOnly: ⛔ Only staff can handle this report.
feedback.closed: ℹ️ This report is already closed.

reports.notConfigured: ❌ No reports channel is configured. An admin must set one on the dashboard.
reports.channelGone: ❌ The reports channel cannot be found. Please tell an administrator.
reports.sendError: ❌ Could not send the report. Check my permissions in the configured channel (View Channel, Send Messages, Create Private Threads, Manage Threads).
reports.invalidMessageLink: ❌ The message link is invalid or does not belong to this server.
reports.submittedWithThread: ✅ Report sent to the staff. You can access the private thread {thread}.
reports.threadIntro: {reporter}, your report about {target} is open here. Only authorized staff can follow this thread with you.

channelId.label: Reports channel
channelId.help: The channel where member reports arrive. Keep it staff-only: a report names the person it targets and quotes their messages. Empty, the command refuses to forward anything.

staffRoleId.label: Staff role notified
staffRoleId.help: The role pinged on each report, so that somebody sees it arrive. With no role the report is posted without notifying anyone — and waits for someone to think of opening the channel.
